cohort: 20,870 women aged 12 to 49 years old from the Demographic and Family Health Survey (ENDES) in Peru
finding: The prevalence of cesarean sections in Peru during 2021 was 33.75%, with significant variation observed based on healthcare system, facility location, and wealth index.
mod_finding: The study found that certain factors, such as healthcare facility type and wealth index, were associated with the likelihood of undergoing a cesarean section.
